verdicts.where: R-1, M1–M2 and Questions settled, Q1
verdicts.quote: `POST /tickets/T-0001/merge` with `{"into":"T-0002"}` … Only the case-sensitive `into` field and canonical ticket IDs are accepted. … A 200 response returns the merged source and target link.
The helpdesk agent chooses the duplicate and target. … T-0001 as `merged` with `mergedInto: "T-0002"` … T-0002 is identical before and afterward.
T-0001 as `merged` with `mergedInto: "T-0002"`. … Merged tickets cannot transition or be patched.
Its original id, title, priority, requester and created time are retained, its updated time records the change, and T-0002 is identical before and afterward.

subsequent GET show T-0001 as `merged` with `mergedInto: "T-0002"`. … The duplicate remains retrievable either by ID or in listings, with `status=merged` filtering it. … existing status-filter semantics are preserved.
Self-merge, closed source, merged destination, reassignment and an attempt to merge a source with an existing incoming link conflict (409). … A target may retain any ordinary status, including closed
verdicts.missing: M3 settles resolved and closed destinations but leaves open whether a resolved source can be merged or receives a conflict.

verdicts.quote: Only the case-sensitive `into` field and canonical ticket IDs are accepted. Leading zero aliases, missing, blank, wrong-typed and oversized inputs follow the existing 400 envelope. An unknown valid source or target returns 404.
verdicts.missing: The specification gives the status codes but leaves open which offending ID or field the error message identifies.

verdicts.quote: Self-merge, closed source, merged destination, reassignment and an attempt to merge a source with an existing incoming link conflict (409).
Exact retries return 200 and the existing source without changing updated, history or outbox.
T-0002 is identical before and afterward. … The target audit and notification outbox are unchanged.

verdicts.where: Questions settled, Q2 and R-1, M2
verdicts.quote: Existing internal API callers may record a merge and attribute it with X-Actor under the current access model … with `system` attribution when the header is absent.
`mergedInto: "T-0002"` … After restart with DATA_FILE, the source link, terminal state, unchanged target and audit remain visible. Previous version-1 files load unchanged.
A file with a merged record and a missing, invalid, self-referential or merged target, or link on an ordinary ticket, is refused.
verdicts.missing: The specification leaves open whether the load error identifies the offending record and what the message says.

verdicts.quote: Each successful new merge appends exactly one source `ticket.merged` audit record with actor, timestamp and changes to status and mergedInto. The target audit and notification outbox are unchanged. Verify via the existing HTTP read endpoints.

A failed save exposes a 500 on the HTTP boundary and leaves the source, target, history and outbox at their prior state. … The existing single-writer JSON snapshot defines capacity and persistence limits.
verdicts.missing: The specification covers a reported write failure but leaves open whether one atomic snapshot save commits the merge and whether a crash during that save recovers the complete old or new state.

verdicts.quote: The target audit and notification outbox are unchanged. … Creation and resolution notifications remain under worker ownership.
The CLI retains its four raw column positions … The read-only CLI uses its existing output conventions.
verdicts.missing: A builder still has to decide how `tickets show` and `tickets list` display merged status and whether and where each prints the survivor ID.

verdicts.quote: Terminal merged status … reassignment and an attempt to merge a source with an existing incoming link conflict (409). … Merged tickets cannot transition or be patched.
verdicts.missing: The terminal state and reassignment conflict rule out ordinary reversal. The procedure an operator follows to correct a mistaken merge is unspecified.

verdicts.quote: Creation, update and transition of ordinary tickets and existing status-filter semantics are preserved. … Verify via the existing HTTP read endpoints.
verdicts.missing: The specification leaves preservation of listing ID order, cursor pagination and the audit endpoint’s existing behavior for unrelated tickets unstated.

verdicts.quote: The CLI retains its four raw column positions, and counts include the merged status. Verify via real HTTP, a persisted file and the CLI/report entry points.
Verify with a failed write simulation and opposing HTTP requests. … Node 22+ and no external dependencies … The release test is `npm test` in a clean local copy
verdicts.missing: A builder still has to decide whether every success and error path needs a test. There is no requirement to update docs/api.md and CHANGELOG, bump the version, write a decision record or implement the merge through a TicketStore method.
